newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Iscor mulls mothballing Pretoria plant.
newsitem.headline: Iscor mulls mothballing Pretoria plant.

text.p: South African iron and steel producer Iscor Ltd is considering mothballing its Pretoria steel mill, endangering 1,400 jobs, the local Business Day newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The paper said this was because the plant had failed to climb out of the red, despite bids to cut costs and change to stainless steel production.
A decision on whether the plant would be permanently shut, mothballed or continued under a more stringent cost-cutting scenario would be made in the next few weeks, the paper said.
Iscor said on Monday it was in talks with stakeholders, including trade unions, on the future of its Pretoria Works.
A company notice said once agreement had been reached, shareholders and other interested parties would be informed of the outcome of the consultations.
